# Spacio Workspace

> Premium coworking space in Basavanagudi, Bengaluru. Private cabins, dedicated desks, meeting rooms, day pass and virtual office for professionals, startups and growing teams in South Bengaluru.

Website: https://www.spacioworkspace.com/
Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Spacio+Workspace/@12.9449135,77.5658325,17z

## Entity

- Name: Spacio Workspace
- Type: Coworking space / private office centre
- Address: No. 7, Sree Devi Complex, N.A.T. Road, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004, India
- Neighbourhood: Basavanagudi, South Bengaluru, near Bull Temple, Lalbagh Botanical Gardens, and Gandhi Bazaar
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70227 80310
- Email: hello@spacioworkspace.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spacioworkspace
- Coordinates: 12.9449135, 77.5658325
- Access: 24/7 for cabin and dedicated-desk members; day pass 9 AM–7 PM
- Internet: 1Gbps

Spacio operates one centre in Basavanagudi. It is not a Jayanagar location.

## Services

- Private cabins: solo, 3-seater and 6-seater
- Dedicated desks
- Day pass coworking
- Meeting rooms (about 4–12 people, AV-ready)
- Virtual office with business address and mail handling

Membership details and commercial rates are shared on enquiry via WhatsApp or a free tour — they are not published on the website.

## How to enquire

1. WhatsApp +91 70227 80310
2. Book a free tour: https://www.spacioworkspace.com/book-tour
3. Visit the Basavanagudi centre
4. Contact: https://www.spacioworkspace.com/contact
